answer: A workable design: split emission across embedding clusters rather than paying per address. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the signal to sunk effort, uses the ledge as an corroborating signal, then requires a summit before any payout.
